remaining_concerns.problem: Safety record omission or nested target/round/phase substitution is accepted by terminal_chain.
remaining_concerns.evidence: safety is allowed empty without checking baseline status/profile/grounded targets; existing safety records only require top-level round==n. Actual CLI852 apply_natural_answer_safety returns zero observations only for baseline profile, noneligible baseline status, or no unique grounded targets. Otherwise it emits one observation per target.
remaining_concerns.fix: Bind pinned profile plus pre-safety status and latest rendered grounded target set. Validate complete safety schema, phase, outer/nested render round and exact unique target coverage. A check(trace,require) interface needs those trusted expectations supplied or verified by capture; do not assume zero records means a legal no-target path.

remaining_concerns.problem: Allowed stage names do not prove legal state transitions.
remaining_concerns.evidence: A second round is accepted after grounded_answer without retry-resolution evidence. Optional canonical/recovery stages need only a label-matching renderer event; malformed/unmatched additional renders are not all consumed.
remaining_concerns.fix: Require round2 transition from prior answer_safety requires_verification plus correctly bound retry grounding that actually changes the artifact. Bind each optional render/stage pair and the host-declared canonical preconditions; reject unconsumed final_render records and wrong phase/round schema. Renderer downgrade/reject stages need their own declared conditions, not a generic len>=1 relaxation.
